text:
Nadia: quick heads-up 1: new mini mock for the private setup network step. goal: make the status row scannable on small screens. link: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE
Will: nice. can we reduce text density? pill labels feel long on mobile. suggest verbs only: "Reachable", "Blocked", "Retrying".
Sofia: a11y note: pills need a 3px focus ring at 2x contrast. also add an aria-label like "Host web-01.example.com, reachable" so SR users get host + status.
Ravi: backend: we'll provide egressIp per probe. put that in a collapsed details row, not the main line.
Nadia: agree. mobile layout: show max 1 host row and a "View all checks" chevron that opens details panel.
Will: validation for CIDR input: inline non-blocking validation, helper text that says "Example: 10.0.0.0/16". detect hostnames and show "Looks like a hostname1 Hosts not accepted here".
Sofia: spinner should use reduced-motion and update an aria-live region with short summaries like "2 of 4 checks passed". don't announce each tiny update.
Ravi: error copy: change "Some checks failed" to "Connectivity checks failed. Try these steps: allow outbound 34.56.78.90:443; retry. If still blocked, contact support". include support email.
Nadia: I'll update Figma notes and ping #design-review after a11y signoff. DesignBot: Mock updated by Nadia at 2026-03-24 09:03 UTC
